checkin.question: How do I check in a team?
checkin.answer: To check in a team, go to the Teams page, find the team, and click the 'Check In' button. This marks the team as present for their matches.

search.question: How do I search for a team?
search.answer: Use the search bar at the top of the Teams page. You can search by team name or filter by sport and status.

create.question: How do I create a new team?
create.answer: Click the 'Create Team' button on the Teams page, fill in the team details, and add players.

verify.question: How do I verify a player?
verify.answer: Click on a team, select the player, review their documents, then mark as Verified or Rejected.

photo.question: How do I change a player photo?
photo.answer: In player details, click the camera icon next to their photo to upload a new one.
steps: Take new photo or select from gallery

reject.question: How do I reject a player verification?
reject.answer: In the player verification screen, select 'Rejected' and provide a reason in the notes field.

create.question: How do I create a tournament?
create.answer: Go to Fixtures page, click 'Create Tournament', select sport and gender, then seed the teams.

seeding.question: How do I seed teams for a tournament?
seeding.answer: In the tournament creation flow, drag and drop teams to arrange them by ranking from 1st to last position.

levels.question: What are cluster, division, and final levels?
levels.answer: Cluster is the first round, Division is for top teams from clusters, and Final is for the best teams to determine the champion.

start.question: How do I start a match?
start.answer: On the Matches page, find the scheduled match and click 'Start Match' to begin scoring.

score.question: How do I enter match scores?
score.answer: During a live match, use the score buttons to update points for each team in real-time.
steps: Use + and - buttons for each team

winner.question: How do I declare a match winner?
winner.answer: After entering final scores, click 'End Match' and confirm the winner to complete the match.

upload.question: How do I upload photos or videos?
upload.answer: Go to Media page, click 'Upload' button, select files from your device or take new photos/videos.
steps: Select files or take new media

offline.question: Can I upload media when offline?
offline.answer: Yes! Media uploads are queued when offline and will automatically sync when you're back online.

create.question: How do I create a post?
create.answer: Go to Posts page, click 'Create Post', write your message, add images if needed, and publish.

visibility.question: Who can see my posts?
visibility.answer: Posts are visible to all volunteers assigned to the same venue. Technical volunteers can create venue-wide announcements.

message.question: How do I send messages to other volunteers?
message.answer: Go to Chat page, type your message in the text box, and press send to communicate with venue volunteers.

urgent.question: How do I report urgent issues?
urgent.answer: Use the chat to send urgent messages, or contact support directly for emergencies requiring immediate attention.

create.question: How do I create notifications?
create.answer: Go to Notifications page, click 'Create Notification', write your message, select recipients, and send.

offline.question: How do I work offline?
offline.answer: The app works offline automatically. Your actions are saved locally and will sync when you're back online.

sync.question: Why is my data not syncing?
sync.answer: Check your internet connection. Pending actions will show in the status bar and sync automatically when online.

mistake.question: What if I make a mistake?
mistake.answer: Most actions can be corrected. Contact support if you need help fixing critical errors like wrong match results.
